name: com.portalrunner/portalrunner-mcp
title: PortalRunner — QuickBooks to Coupa AP Autopilot
description: QBO-to-Coupa AP portal invoice autopilot, silent-rejection radar, and Ed25519 receipt verifier.

tools.name: list_invoice_jobs
tools.description: Lists QuickBooks Online to Coupa AP portal invoice jobs from D1, including statuses (submitted, staged_draft, halted_drift, rejected_silent), PO numbers, dollar totals, Ed25519 verification state, and Coupa confirmation IDs.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. submitted, staged_draft, halted_drift, rejected_silent).

tools.name: check_silent_rejections
tools.description: Returns silent AP portal rejections and pre-submit Halt-on-Drift invoice items currently stalling Net-60 payment clocks, including DSO days at risk, dollar exposure, and reason codes.

tools.name: verify_ed25519_receipt
tools.description: Runs live Cloudflare Workers Web Crypto Ed25519 cryptographic signature and SHA-256 canonical payload verification on any PortalRunner Proof Receipt JSON.

receipt_json.description: JSON string of a PortalRunner SignedProofReceipt (algorithm: Ed25519, payload, payload_sha256, public_key_b64, signature_b64).

tools.name: simulate_coupa_po_flip
tools.description: Runs a dry-run penny-exact QuickBooks Online to Coupa CSP PO-flip simulation. Pass inject_drift_cents (e.g. 1 for +$0.01) to trigger the pre-submit Halt-on-Drift guardrail, or omit/set 0 to mint and verify a real Ed25519 Proof Receipt.

inject_drift_cents.description: Optional tax/rounding drift in cents to inject (e.g. 1 for +$0.01 Halt-on-Drift check). Defaults to 0 (penny-exact pass).

invoice_number.description: Optional QBO invoice document number (default: INV-1088).

buyer_name.description: Optional Coupa buyer entity name (default: CommonSpirit Health — Facilities Procurement).

mode.description: Execution mode: autopilot (submit) or draft_first (stage draft for 1-click approval). Default: autopilot.
